product.title: 6hr 12 Passenger Mercedes Limo Sprinter Bus

description.text: Tour Napa or Sonoma Valley in a Mercedes limo sprinter bus built for groups up to twelve passengers. This six-hour private charter includes flexible winery selection, onboard space to stand comfortably, and experienced planning for a VIP wine tasting day.

highlights: Mercedes sprinter limo bus for up to twelve passengers

Ideal for celebrations and group wine country outings
